hazards.survival_rule_type: shelter during a measurable pressure change
hazards.rule: When the gauge drops, shut your door.
hazards.consequence: The pressure outside crushes your lungs.
hazards.threat: Pressure falls without warning outside the sleeping rooms.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep in the pressure-sealed caretaker booth.
hazards.last: A falling gauge means you must seal your door.

hazards.rule: Never answer when the caretaker calls your number.
hazards.consequence: Answering lets the caretaker enter your shelter.
hazards.threat: The caretaker collects anyone who answers its nightly roll call.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep behind a latched service hatch.
hazards.last: Never answer when the caretaker calls your number.

hazards.rule: Replace the booth battery before its light turns blue.
hazards.consequence: An unlit booth loses its breathable air.
hazards.threat: Only the lit booths contain breathable air after dark.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep in a booth with a working lamp.
hazards.last: Replace your battery before the booth light turns blue.

hazards.rule: Always clock out before the second bell.
hazards.consequence: Late workers must stand at their post until tomorrow.
hazards.threat: The workers chain late arrivals to their workstations.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep in a signed-out worker bunk.
hazards.last: Clock out before the second bell or lose tomorrow.

hazards.rule: Keep one hand on the handrail when returning home.
hazards.consequence: Releasing it sends you to an unheated duplicate building.
hazards.threat: The access paths change destination when nobody touches them.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep in the only heated service cabin.
hazards.last: Keep touching the handrail or you cannot get home.

hazards.rule: Only eat food that makes the test strip green.
hazards.consequence: Untested food seals your mouth shut for three days.
hazards.threat: Identical food packets have different effects on your body.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep in a bolted inspection cubicle.
hazards.last: Test every meal or your mouth seals shut.

hazards.rule: Stay under a roof when the rain turns white.
hazards.consequence: White rain hardens every joint it touches.
hazards.threat: White rain makes exposed limbs permanently rigid.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep under the concrete loading canopy.
hazards.last: Stay indoors when the rain turns white.

hazards.rule: Stay off the yellow line after the third horn.
hazards.consequence: The cleaning machine folds everything on the line into its hopper.
hazards.threat: A nightly cleaning machine follows the painted route through every room.
hazards.sleep: You can sleep on the raised inspection shelf.
hazards.last: The third horn means get off the yellow line.

costs.detail: You must pump the drinking water by hand for four hours every day.
Only one meal arrives daily, regardless of how much you work.
The shelter alarm wakes you every two hours for the rest of your life.
Your whole life must fit inside the fenced service compound.
The cold takes feeling from your fingertips permanently each winter.
You must keep an unresponsive neighbor fed to retain your shelter.
You can only leave the sleeping booth after natural daylight has ended.
Your safe sleeping room changes every night; you can never settle.

impossible_properties: The ceiling shows a different season through every skylight.
Every window looks onto the underside of the building.
A second horizon is visible inside a locked glass cabinet.
The nearest room casts a shadow through all the others.
All falling objects stop an inch above the floor.
Sunlight comes from a drain that nobody can open.

mock_variants.food: A hatch dispenses one tin of beans every morning.
mock_variants.narration: Your daily meal comes through a hatch.
mock_variants.routine: You wash your tin and slide it back before the hatch closes.

mock_variants.food: You must trade scavenged copper for dried peas at the intake counter.
mock_variants.narration: Trade copper scraps for dried peas.
mock_variants.routine: You weigh copper scraps on the counter before each meal.

mock_variants.food: A hand-cranked dispenser yields bread after an hour of turning.
mock_variants.narration: You crank a handle for bread.
mock_variants.routine: You wrap the crank in spare cloth to protect your hands.
